response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and general programming skills, but the resume shows no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no embedded Linux kernel development, and no experience with the required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) or switch/networking domains. His technical background is fundamentally misaligned with this embedded security engineering role.
strengths: 12+ years of professional software development experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated experience with C/C++ in a prior role (NI LabWindows/CVI)
Strong track record of ownership, testing discipline, and cross-functional collaboration
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, which is a mandatory native-level requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation, modification, or embedded systems experience
No background in network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, switch chips) or L2/L3 networking

key_factors.factor: No embedded/Linux kernel or security domain experience
